crossRefs.note: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of…
crossRefs.keyword: with him. Heb. in his hand. the day appointed. or, the newmoon

translations.web: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
translations.bsb: He took with him a bag of money and will not return till the moon is full.”
translations.kjv: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
translations.asv: He hath taken a bag of money with him; He will come home at the full moon.
